title.narrative: CORE FUNDING TO SUPPORT THE 2021-2025 STRATEGY OF THE INSTITUTE FOR SECURITY STUDIES (ISS) REGIONAL OFFICE FOR WEST AFRICA BASED IN DAKAR, SENEGAL.

description.narrative: This grant will provide core funding to support the 2021-2025 strategy of the Institute for Security Studies (ISS) regional office for West Africa based in Dakar, Senegal. The funding aims to contribute to advancing Africa's promise of peace and prosperity. The objectives of the grant are: Outcome 1: Decision makers on African human security and development challenges are informed by ISS research and analysis. Outcome 2: Participants in ISS-convened dialogues and gatherings influence policy debates about human security challenges in Africa. Outcome 3: Policies, strategies, programmes in key institutions dealing with Africa’s human security challenges are improved. Outcome 4: Stakeholders’ capacity is built to effectively intervene with the aim of improving human security in Africa; to provide ongoing, tailored research support and specialised expertise; increase Irish and African linkages, networks and cooperation; and provide in-depth and commissioned country/topic-specific analysis and policy recommendations. The key activities include providing ongoing, tailored research support and specialised expertise; increasing Irish and African linkages, networks and cooperation; and the provision of in-depth and commissioned country/topic-specific analysis and policy recommendations.
